statement: Proper cube rotations form a group of order 24; for any R1,R2, their composition and inverse recover the source octant and covariantly relabeled ordered RGB secondary and primary identities.
scope: Discrete signed-permutation matrices with determinant +1. UV and IR copy symbolic address labels, not real RGB frequencies; no CERN experiment implied.
conservation: Preserves origin identity by invertible transformations; spatial position and channel name can change under covariant relabeling.
caveat: Not valid for arbitrary SO(3) rotations that send octant coordinate vertices off the eight-corner set.
